title: GDEC Phase A Verification Result Schema

id.description: Identifier of the verification check (e.g., A2.1a, A2.2_symmetry, etc.)

computed.description: Structured computed numerical values from the test execution

threshold.description: Frozen threshold values against which computed values are evaluated

pass.description: Whether the test met the required frozen threshold

failure_class.description: Classification of failure: INFRA (environment/dependency), IMPL_DEFECT (code deviates from mathematical spec), NUM_FAIL (numerical threshold violated), REF_UNCERTAIN (reference convergence inadequate), SPEC_AMBIG (ambiguous specification)

details.description: Detailed notes, diagnostic traces, or contextual commentary
